name: looking-glass-companion
description: Private local workspace coordination and saved-buffer language providers for Looking Glass.

commands.title: Looking Glass: Connect to Looking Glass

lookingGlass.serverUrl.description: Local server origin. Used only after explicit Connect; credentials are never stored in settings.

scripts.package: npm run build && vsce package --no-dependencies --allow-missing-repository --skip-license --out looking-glass-companion-0.1.0.vsix
scripts.publish: node -e "throw new Error('Private extension: install the local VSIX; publishing is disabled')"
